proposals.before: (The Old History of the Tang states he was a man of Xing Prefecture; the Comprehensive Mirror states he was a man of Qian Prefecture.)〉
proposals.after: (Ouyang Xiu's history states he was a man of Xing Prefecture; the Comprehensive Mirror states he was a man of Qian Prefecture.)〉
proposals.reason: 歐陽史 refers to Ouyang Xiu's history, not the Old Tang History.

proposals.before: The Old History of the Tang states: In the first year of Tianfu the Liang sent Shi Shuzong to attack Jin, coming out through Tianjing Pass; Qian opened the gates and surrendered, guiding the Liang army to attack Taiyuan, but they did not take it;
proposals.after: Ouyang Xiu's history states: In the first year of Tianfu the Liang sent Shi Shuzong to attack Jin, coming out through Tianjing Pass; Qian opened the gates and surrendered, guiding the Liang army to attack Taiyuan, but they did not take it;
proposals.reason: 歐陽史 is Ouyang Xiu's history, not the Old Tang History.

proposals.before: Wenli exploited their disaffection and secretly incited them: "The prince has ordered me to slaughter you all. I remember how for more than ten years you bore arms for me, for family and state alike; if I obey and kill you, I betray you;
proposals.after: Wenli exploited their disaffection and secretly incited them: "The lord has ordered me to bury you all alive. I remember how for more than ten years you bore arms and followed me, for family and state; if I do not kill you at once, I offend the lord;
proposals.reason: Chinese 我若不即殺爾，則得罪於令公 means if he does NOT kill them at once he offends the lord; idiomatic reverses the conditional.

proposals.before: Thereafter Zhang pleaded that the land was narrow and the people poor, and only ten thousand tribute was permitted.
proposals.after: Thereafter Zhang pleaded that the land was narrow and the people poor, and only one hundred thousand tribute was permitted.
proposals.reason: 十萬 means one hundred thousand, not ten thousand.

decisions.reason: s0003 cites 《歐陽史》, Ouyang Xiu's history (Xin Wudai Shi), not the Old Tang History; the proposed literal matches the source label already used in the idiomatic.
s0055 again opens with 《歐陽史》云; rendering that as the Old History of the Tang invents the wrong work, and Ouyang Xiu's history restores the citation.
s0080 has 我若不即殺爾，則得罪於令公 (if I do not kill you at once, I offend the lord); the prior idiomatic reverses the conditional, and 盡坑爾曹 / 荷戈隨我 support bury-alive and followed-me.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 我若不即殺爾，則得罪於令公

decisions.reason: s0124 reads 許貢十萬而已; 十萬 is one hundred thousand, matching the idiomatic and contrasting the prior demand of 五十萬.
